terminology.problem: Three different names are in circulation for the same four class enhancement nodes, and an earlier version of this file mixed them without saying so.
terminology.resolution: They are two ends of one mechanic, not three different things. maplestorywiki lists Eternal Light Boost, Sentinel Rise Boost, Eternal Guardian Boost and Destruction of Roan Boost under 'HEXA Enhancements' - these are the BOOST NODES. The Erda Link page states, verbatim, that a 'Skill Stone enhances Boost Nodes and Common Nodes if connected Rush Stones are activated'. So Eikonal's workbook legend name 'Eternal Guardian Skill Stone' names the stone that enhances the node named 'Eternal Guardian Boost'. The same workbook's goal rows use the node name ('Goal: Unlock first Eternal Guardian Boost'), which is why both appear in one document.
terminology.doNotConfuseWith: The workbook legend's separate entry 'Boost stone (B)' is the GENERIC Erda Link stone type, not these nodes. Rows tagged (B) in the ordering are flat stat purchases - '10% boss dmg (B)', '1000 STR (B)', '20 ATK (B)' - and the Erda Link page defines Boost Stone as a stone that 'activates certain effects under certain conditions if Light Power is activated'. Rows tagged (R), (U), (L), (D) are Rush Stones on the right, up, left and down paths.
terminology.canonicalName: Use the maplestorywiki node name - '<X> Boost' - in any user-facing string. Keep 'Skill Stone' only when quoting Eikonal's workbook. The phrase 'Eternal Guardian boost stone', used in an earlier version of this file, appears in no source and has been removed.

hexa.notes: ERDA LINK, NOT HEXA MATRIX. ERDA LINK MECHANICS (maplestorywiki /w/Erda_Link, re-read 2026-09-12, page last edited 2026-07-05, self-flagged as a stub): six stone types, upgraded with Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments - Origin Stone (unlocked automatically upon Job Advancement, enhances Skill Nodes); Ultimate Stone (enhances Mastery Nodes if Light Power is activated); Skill Stone (enhances Boost Nodes and Common Nodes if connected Rush Stones are activated); Boost Stone (activates certain effects under certain conditions if Light Power is activated); Rush Stone (adds bonus stats and connects stones through paths); SHINE Stone (bonus stats equivalent to HEXA Stats). Light Power is activated by clicking a button in the Erda Link UI, which shows a glowing yellow box; the box grows as stones are unlocked, and a 6th job skill is unlocked in the Skill window when the box surrounds it. PLANNING CONSEQUENCE WORTH SURFACING TO USERS: the same page states that SHINE Stone enhancement 'requires Meso in addition to Sol Erda/Fragments, and failure can decrease the stone's level'. That is a risk profile HEXA Stat does not have, and any Erda Link planner must model it rather than treating SHINE Stones as deterministic. Eikonal's workbook says its own SHINE Stone fragment costs are EXPECTED (average) costs for exactly that reason, and several of its comments ('but I'm risk averse so ...', 'gamba enjoyers can grab this a few goals earlier') are about that variance. SCOPE OF THE ORDERING RECORDED ABOVE: the complete sequence is 49 goals over 111 purchase rows, and ALL of it is recorded, read verbatim. An earlier version of this file recorded only the first 15 rows and guessed the total at 'roughly 70 goals'; both have been corrected. WORKBOOK TOTALS, from its own Summarised Info block: 1166 Sol Erda (its note says this excludes things like Janus and drop rate/exp rush stones), 38187 fragments (its note says quite a few niche stones are not accounted for, pointing at the Technical Notes tab), and 133.890% total final damage gain relative to a fresh 6th job. Per-skill FD contributions in that block: M1 Spear of Lugh 39.675, Shinestones (16 all) 21.211, Eternal Guardian 15.935, M2 Sting/Fury of Roan 14.200, Hecate 11.517, Erda Link passives 10.668, Ascent 6.235, Origin 6.015, Destruction of Roan 3.686, Sentinel Rise 3.109, Eternal Light 1.639, Tree of Stars (CC3) left blank. Summary of non-Shinestone Erda Link bonuses, also from that block: 36% boss/dmg/abnormal dmg, 5% crit rate, 7% IED, 4% crit damage, 36 atk, 6% all stat, 1450 STR, 200 DEX, 13% buff duration, 15% normal damage, 5% exp, 12% drop rate, 2% meso, 30% exp every 30s for every 250 combo kills, 0.5% chance to reduce a skill's remaining cooldown by 20%, 10 sacred power. COLUMN NOTE: only columns A and B carry exported headers ('SKILL', 'LEVEL'). The remaining five columns are unlabelled in the export, but their meaning is arithmetically certain and was checked across rows: C = Sol Erda cost, D = fragment cost, E = cumulative fragments, F = final damage percent gained, G = F divided by D times 100. An earlier version of this file asserted header strings ('ERDA', 'FRAGS', 'CUMULATIVE FRAGS', 'FD (%)', 'EFFICIENCY (FD%/100 FRAGS)') that are not in the exported sheet; the arithmetic definition above replaces them. KNOWN TYPO IN THE SOURCE: in goal 19 the cumulative-fragment cell for Shinestone #1 12->13 reads 5032.5, lower than the 5090.5 above it; the next row resumes at 5161.6. The cumulative column is therefore low by roughly 129 from that point on, which is part of why the final cumulative cell (37999.9) does not match the stated 38187 total. Values are transcribed as printed rather than silently repaired. WHY UNLOCK ROWS SCORE NEAR ZERO: a row like '200 DEX (D) + (mains) Sol Janus or (mules) 2% normal dmg (L)' buys Rush Stones that extend Light Power far enough to reach a node; it delivers almost no damage itself, so its efficiency is near zero by construction. The payoff is always the row immediately after it. Do not present these rows to a user as low-value purchases - present each goal as a unit. MODELLING ASSUMPTIONS the author states on the Technical Notes tab: Janus assumed unlocked to get M1 into the light zone (with a DEX rush stone); far-left rush stones assumed unlocked before the 20 ATK boost stone; RoR4/WJ4 rings assumed, to be revised after ring changes; a -2 cooldown hat assumed, which favours the class's 10 second cooldown skills; Passives +1 inner ability assumed, so +2 passives with DCO; stat-to-FD conversions averaged from the author's own roughly 280-300m CP characters, with a note that FD for IED is somewhat overvalued in party play; various small and niche Erda Link stats not accounted for; and a 20 minute boss fight assumed when valuing Ascent, which the author says is more impactful in shorter fights. NAME ALLOWLIST FOR 6TH JOB, complete as of maplestorywiki /w/Erel_Light/Skills re-read 2026-09-12 (page last edited 2026-09-09, the v.271 patch date): class-specific skills are Fall of Melin (master level 30, 360 second cooldown, invincible during casting) and Radiant Spear (master level 30, invincible during casting, Ignore Defense +60%, Boss Damage +40%, Critical Rate 100%); Mastery skills are SHINE Spear of Lugh, SHINE Fury of Roan and SHINE Sting of Roan; Enhancement (boost) nodes are Eternal Light Boost, Sentinel Rise Boost, Eternal Guardian Boost and Destruction of Roan Boost; shared skills are Sol Janus (with Sol Janus: Dawn and Sol Janus: Dusk), Sol Hecate (with Sol Hecate: Styx, Sol Hecate: Phlegethon, Sol Hecate: Charon and Sol Hecate: Pactum) and SHINE Tree of Stars. An earlier version of this allowlist omitted SHINE Tree of Stars and the Phlegethon, Charon and Pactum forms of Sol Hecate, which would have caused a downstream consumer to reject four real names - the workbook's 'Tree of Stars (CC3)' row and its 'phlegethon burst at lvl 30' comment both refer to skills that were missing from it. Do not emit any 6th job node name outside this list.

gearingNotes: No exotic stat model. Erel Light is a conventional STR main / DEX secondary warrior - unlike Demon Avenger it has no HP-as-damage-stat quirk, and unlike Xenon it has no cross-branch gear decision. The class-specific gearing facts that ARE sourced, all from the skill tables at maplestorywiki.net/w/Erel_Light/Skills: SELF-SOURCED CRITICAL RATE IS LARGE. Named passive and buff sources are Radiant Shock (Critical Rate +15% at max), Radiant Dawn (Critical Rate +20% at level 10, +22% at level 12), and the Light Enchant buff (Critical Rate +10% at max, 200 second duration). Two hyper passives add a further +20% critical rate each but only to Fury of Roan and to Sting of Roan specifically, not globally. The individual values are recorded rather than summed because no source publishes an Erel Light critical rate target or states where investment should stop - that calculation is left to the reader rather than asserted here. SELF-SOURCED IGNORE DEFENSE IS ALSO LARGE. Radiant Control gives Ignore Defense +40% at level 15; Path of Fionn carries Ignore Defense +100% on the skill itself; the 6th job skill Radiant Spear carries Ignore Defense +60%, Boss Damage +40% and a flat 100% critical rate; boost nodes for Spear of Lugh, Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan each add Ignored Enemy Defense +20% at node level 40. BOSS DAMAGE FROM PASSIVES: Radiant Control gives Boss Damage +20% at level 15, before the Boss Rush hyper passive and the legion effect. SURVIVABILITY IS UNUSUALLY SELF-CONTAINED: Radiant Hold (Max HP +10%, damage taken -20%, knockback resistance +40%) and Radiant Will (Max HP +20%, damage taken -20%, knockback resistance +60%) stack, and Shield of Chulainn passively creates a barrier absorbing up to 30% of Max HP whenever Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan are comboed off Spear of Lugh - which the FAQ notes happens naturally in the normal attack loop. Max HP therefore has real defensive value on this class beyond survival floor. BUFF DURATION MATTERS MORE THAN AVERAGE: the class's own link skill grants Buff Duration +19%, and its two main buffs (Light Enchant, Helian Blessing) both run 200 seconds. ERDA LINK RESOURCE RISK: SHINE Stone enhancement consumes Meso in addition to Sol Erda and Sol Erda Fragments and can fail, lowering the stone's level - budget for that, unlike HEXA Stat.

conflicts.issue: Boost node tier versus per-level value for Spear of Light
conflicts.positionA: Grandis Library's embedded page data classes Spear of Light Boost as Secondary (index 3), below Spear of Lugh, Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan.
conflicts.positionB: maplestorywiki's V Enhancement table gives Spear of Light Boost 3% final damage per level, the highest of any Erel Light node, while all three of Grandis's Primary nodes are listed at 2% per level.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED. Both facts were re-read on 2026-09-12 and both stand exactly as stated. A plausible reconciliation is that the three Primary skills are cast far more often than the Spear of Light summon, so absolute contribution differs from per-level rate, but no source says this and it is not asserted here.

conflicts.issue: Which 6th job skill is Origin and which is Ascent
conflicts.positionA: maplestorywiki lists exactly two class-specific 6th job skills, Fall of Melin (master level 30, 360 second cooldown, invincible during casting) and Radiant Spear (master level 30, invincible during casting, no cooldown printed), and labels neither as Origin or Ascent.
conflicts.positionB: Eikonal's workbook has dedicated 'Origin' and 'Ascent' tabs and separate goal rows for each, but refers to them only by those generic role names, never by skill name. Its Technical Notes tab says Ascent 'is more impactful for shorter boss fights' and that the summary assumes a 20 minute fight of '3 full rotations + a single 2 min rotation with ori', which still does not name either skill.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED and deliberately not guessed. The 360 second cooldown on Fall of Melin is the usual signature of an Origin skill, but the invincibility frame the workbook attributes to Ascent is printed on BOTH wiki entries, so the available evidence points in opposite directions and settles nothing. Any UI that needs to show an Origin or Ascent skill name for Erel Light must confirm the mapping from a source before displaying it. This blocks no recommendation in this file: every Erda Link order row uses the workbook's own generic names, transcribed verbatim.

conflicts.issue: Does a community 6th job build exist for Erel Light
conflicts.positionA: The Erel Light FAQ states, verbatim: 'There is currently no 6th Job build made by the community yet.'
conflicts.positionB: Eikonal's Erda Link Progression workbook is exactly such a build - 49 ordered goals with cost and efficiency per row - and Grandis Library links it from the Erel Light page.
conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED because neither artifact carries a date. The likeliest explanation is that the FAQ statement predates the workbook and was never updated, but that is inference, not evidence. Consumers should treat the workbook as the current answer and the FAQ line as probably stale.

evidenceWarning: THE THREE-INDEPENDENT-SOURCES BAR IS NOT MET FOR ANY JUDGEMENT CLAIM IN THIS FILE, and the app must not present Erel Light advice with the confidence it gives a class like Bow Master. Three independent sources exist for FACTS (maplestorywiki, the Erel Light FAQ, and Eikonal's Erda Link workbook), but every judgement field rests on exactly one: boost node tiering, hyper passives and training inner ability come only from Grandis Library; the Erda Link investment order comes only from Eikonal's workbook; the bossing inner ability lines appear in two places that share one community. PRECISION ABOUT THAT ATTRIBUTION, corrected in this pass: Grandis Library's credits block attributes exactly two things - 'Skill Icons + Animations: Ikasuu' and 'Inner Ability + Hyper Passive Build: Erel Light Discord'. It attributes the boost node tiering to nobody. An earlier version of this file said the credits block attributed the tiering to the Discord as well; that overstated what the page says. The tiering is unattributed single-source material, which is neither better nor worse than Discord-attributed material, but it should be described accurately. Four structural reasons this class is worse-sourced than most: (1) it is roughly three months old, released in v.269; (2) Grandis Library links no Class Doc for it, meaning no maintained class guide document exists; (3) the FAQ that stands in for one self-describes as a placeholder; (4) because the class is GMS-exclusive, the NamuWiki / KMS cross-check lane that provides genuine independence for most classes does not exist at all. ADDITIONAL GAPS: reddit.com was not reachable in the mining pass, so r/Maplestory Erel Light discussion is entirely unexamined; no YouTube guide pass was run; and the Erel Light Discord itself - which the FAQ, both sheets and Grandis's judgement sections all originate from - was not read. Anyone extending this file should start there. WHAT IS NOT A GAP ANY MORE: the Erda Link investment ordering is now recorded in full (49 goals, 111 rows) rather than truncated at 15, and every 6th job skill name in the allowlist has been checked against the live wiki.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.

resolutionPass.scope: vMatrix, hexa, hyperSkills, hyperStats and innerAbility only. Job 1-4 skill builds, skill damage coefficients, damage lines, job tiers and rotations were out of scope by product decision and were not touched.
resolutionPass.method: Every cited page was re-opened and the exact disputed claim checked against it. maplestorywiki, which the contest agent could not reach (HTTP 403 on every route), is reachable with a normal browser User-Agent and was read in full. Eikonal's workbook was read tab by tab through the gviz CSV endpoint, including its tab list, so the 'gviz returns only the first sheet' limitation the contest agent hit did not apply. No new sources were sought; every URL used here was already cited in the file.

resolved.defect: No skill or node name could be disproven; naming discipline is broadly sound and the refusal to guess the Origin/Ascent mapping is correct and confirmed (both rows exist unnamed in the sheet).
resolved.whatIDid: Re-checked. The Origin and Ascent rows exist in the workbook as generic role names, and the workbook additionally has dedicated 'Origin' and 'Ascent' tabs that also never name the skill. maplestorywiki labels neither Fall of Melin nor Radiant Spear as Origin or Ascent. The refusal to guess stands and remains recorded in conflicts. Separately, the naming claim was found to be wrong in the other direction: the allowlist was incomplete, not incorrect - see the allowlist entry below.

resolved.defect: Terminology conflation: the sheet reads 'Eternal Guardian Skill Stone'; the file calls it 'Eternal Guardian boost stone' in four steps. The file's own Erda Link mechanics section defines Skill Stone and Boost Stone as distinct types, and its allowlist introduces a third name, 'Eternal Guardian Boost', as an Enhancement node. Three names, no disambiguation.
resolved.whatIDid: The critic is right that the file mixed three names with no disambiguation, and one of the three - 'Eternal Guardian boost stone' - was the file's own invention, appearing in neither source. Added hexa.terminology, which resolves the other two against their sources rather than hedging: maplestorywiki's Erda Link page states verbatim that a 'Skill Stone enhances Boost Nodes and Common Nodes if connected Rush Stones are activated', so the workbook's legend name 'Eternal Guardian Skill Stone' names the stone and maplestorywiki's 'Eternal Guardian Boost' names the node it enhances - two ends of one mechanic. The workbook itself uses both, calling the node 'Eternal Guardian Boost' in its goal headers while its legend says 'Eternal Guardian Skill Stone'. The generic 'Boost stone (B)' in the legend is a third, different thing and is only ever used in the ordering for flat stat purchases such as '10% boss dmg (B)', '1000 STR (B)' and '20 ATK (B)'. Canonical user-facing name set to the maplestorywiki node name. The invented phrase has been removed everywhere; the ordering now quotes the workbook's goal text verbatim instead of paraphrasing it.

resolved.defect: Unverified as discrete rows: the separate 'Unlock the M1 mastery' (50, eff 0.18) and 'Unlock the first Eternal Guardian boost stone' (100, eff 0.10) steps. The sheet's prerequisites appeared as rush stones at 0-2 Erda, not at these costs. Possibly real rows on a tab I could not read, possibly reconstructed.
resolved.whatIDid: Both rows are real and are printed exactly as the file recorded them. Under 'Goal: Unlock M1 Spear of Lugh': '200 DEX (D) + (mains) Sol Janus or (mules) 2% normal dmg (L)', level '-', 1 Sol Erda, 50 fragments, cumulative 50, FD 0.09180, efficiency 0.18359. Under 'Goal: Unlock first Eternal Guardian Boost': '1% IED (R) + 1% IED (R)', level '-', 2 Sol Erda, 100 fragments, cumulative 763, FD 0.10091, efficiency 0.10091. The contest agent's observation that these are rush stones at 0-2 Erda is correct and not in conflict: the Erda figure is the Sol Erda cost, while the 50 and 100 figures the file quoted are the FRAGMENT cost. The M1 and M2 prerequisites are independently corroborated by the FAQ, which answers 'How do I unlock my Masteries?' with 'M1: Unlock Normal Enemy Damage (or Sol Janus) and DEX. M2: Unlock DEX and one of the 3 Ignore Defense passives on the right.' One wording correction was made: the file described the M2 prerequisite as '2% Ignore Defense stones', where the workbook reads '2% IED (R) + 1% IED (R)'.

resolved.defect: Unverified names: 'Sol Hecate' and 'Sol Hecate: Styx' in the 6th job allowlist. The sheet says only 'Hecate'; maplestorywiki was unreachable (HTTP 403 on every route), so the 'Sol' prefix is uncorroborated.
resolved.disposition: REFUTED - CLAIM CONFIRMED AGAINST THREE SOURCES
resolved.whatIDid: maplestorywiki is reachable with a browser User-Agent and carries 42 occurrences of 'Sol Hecate', including the skill headings 'Sol Hecate', 'Sol Hecate: Styx', 'Sol Hecate: Phlegethon', 'Sol Hecate: Charon' and 'Sol Hecate: Pactum'. The Erel Light FAQ independently writes 'You can bind Sol Hecate: Styx to one of the buffs with a 60 second cooldown'. Eikonal's workbook, which abbreviates to 'Hecate' in its ordering, spells it out on its Hecate tab: 'This spreadsheet computes the FD gain per level of Sol Hecate'. Three sources, three authors. The name stands and is now the best-sourced 6th job claim in the file.

resolved.defect: Omission that alters the recommendation: the sheet's opening rows include Sentinel Rise Skill Stone L1 (efficiency 1.54) and Destruction of Roan Skill Stone L1, with Eternal Guardian at row 4 right after the masteries. Neither Sentinel Rise nor Destruction of Roan appears anywhere in the file's 15-step order, though Sentinel Rise's 1.54 outranks included steps SHINE Stone #2 (1.22) and M2 to level 3 (1.12). Caveat: gviz returns only the first sheet, so a tab difference could explain part of this.
resolved.disposition: PARTLY REFUTED, PARTLY CONFIRMED - AND THE UNDERLYING PROBLEM FIXED BY RECORDING THE WHOLE ORDERING
resolved.whatIDid: REFUTED on the placement claim. What the contest agent read as 'the sheet's opening rows' is the colour-key LEGEND in column A rows 2 to 14, which lists the stone TYPES used in the workbook (M1: Spear of Lugh, M2: Sting/Fury of Roan, Sentinel Rise Skill Stone, Eternal Guardian Skill Stone, Destruction of Roan Skill Stone, Eternal Light Skill Stone, Origin, Ascent, Hecate, Tree of Stars (CC3), Shinestones, Rush stone, Boost stone). It is a key, not an order. The ordering begins at row 23, and in it Sentinel Rise (1) level 1 is goal 18 at cumulative fragment 5090.5, while Destruction of Roan (1) level 1 is goal 23 at cumulative 6770.6. Eternal Guardian (1) level 1 sits at cumulative 800, which is exactly where the file had it. Both the WIP and the OUTDATED summary tabs open identically, so the tab caveat does not change this. CONFIRMED on a real error the defect surfaced: the file's step 12 read 'Unlock the second Eternal Guardian boost stone, including the critical damage stones required on the path, and take it to level 10. Cost 150 fragments, efficiency 0.79' - which quoted the goal header but only the PREREQUISITE row's numbers, silently dropping the actual purchase row 'Eternal Guardian (2), 1 --> 6, 8 Sol Erda, 191 fragments, FD 2.92135, efficiency 1.52950'. That is the same conflation of goal header with purchase row the defect points at, and it understated that goal's value. FIX: rather than patch fifteen hand-copied steps, the entire ordering was re-read and transcribed - 49 goals, 111 rows, every row with its level range, Sol Erda cost, fragment cost, cumulative fragments, FD gain and efficiency exactly as printed, plus the author's own comments attached to the goals they annotate. Nothing is summarised and nothing is dropped, so this class of error cannot recur.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during this pass and not raised by the contest agent: the 6th job name allowlist was incomplete, and the field instructs downstream code to use it as a rejection list.
resolved.whatIDid: The allowlist omitted SHINE Tree of Stars and the Phlegethon, Charon and Pactum forms of Sol Hecate, all four of which are on maplestorywiki. Because the field says 'Do not emit any 6th job node name outside this list', those omissions would have caused four real names to be rejected - and the workbook uses two of them, in its 'Tree of Stars (CC3)' row and its 'phlegethon burst at lvl 30' comment. All four added.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during this pass: hexa.notes asserted column header strings that do not exist in the source, and a goal count that was a guess.
resolved.whatIDid: The file listed the workbook's columns as 'SKILL, LEVEL, ERDA, FRAGS, CUMULATIVE FRAGS, FD (%), EFFICIENCY (FD%/100 FRAGS)'. Only 'SKILL' and 'LEVEL' are present as header text; the other five columns are unlabelled in the export. Replaced the invented header strings with the arithmetically verified meaning of each column. Also replaced 'the full ordering runs to roughly 70 goals; only the first 15 are recorded above because only those could be read verbatim' with the true count - 49 goals, 111 rows - all of which are now recorded. Recorded the source's own cumulative-fragment typo at goal 20 rather than silently repairing it.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during this pass: two shape problems where the data structure asserted a ranking no source states.
resolved.whatIDid: (1) vMatrix.priority is an ordered array, but Grandis Library publishes an unordered three-tier classification. Added orderedWithinTier: false, an explicit tiers object holding the three unordered sets, and an orderingCaveat telling downstream code not to read position within a tier as priority. The array is kept because the TIER sequence is source-supported; the order inside each tier is not. (2) hyperSkills.passivesRecommended is an ordered array, but Grandis publishes a set of five picks grouped for display by base skill. Added passivesRecommendedIsOrdered: false with the same warning. By contrast hexa.order legitimately IS ordered - the workbook publishes it as a sequenced greedy ranking on FD per fragment - and is flagged orderIsOrdered: true alongside the author's own two caveats about erda-gating and lookahead horizon. innerAbility bossing and training lists were likewise flagged unordered, with Grandis's verbatim note that the two training meso/drop lines are interchangeable between line 1 and line 2.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during this pass: evidenceWarning overstated what Grandis Library's credits block says.
resolved.whatIDid: The file said Grandis's credits block attributes its judgement fields, including boost node tiering, to the Erel Light Discord. The block names exactly two contributions: 'Skill Icons + Animations: Ikasuu' and 'Inner Ability + Hyper Passive Build: Erel Light Discord'. The boost node tiering is unattributed. Corrected in evidenceWarning, in the sources entry for Grandis Library, and in every vMatrix consensusNote, which now say the tiering is single-source and unattributed rather than claiming a Discord provenance the page does not state. No consensus label changes as a result - all were and remain weak.

resolved.defect: NEW, found during this pass: innerAbility paraphrased the FAQ's condition on the abnormal-status line in a way the FAQ does not support.
resolved.whatIDid: The file said the FAQ 'makes the abnormal-status damage line contingent on actually having a source of abnormal status, and points at a Mage link skill as the pairing'. The FAQ actually says: 'Abnormal Damage might not be good in Challenger's World but with Mage Link on your main world it's best.' The substance is close but the framing is the FAQ's world type, not a generic contingency. Replaced the paraphrase with the verbatim quote in innerAbility.bossingConditional.

contest.shipReadyNote: Applies to the five endgame sections only: vMatrix, hexa, hyperSkills, hyperStats, innerAbility. Every claim in those five was re-read against its cited source on 2026-09-12 and is either confirmed, corrected to match the source, or deleted. Consensus labels remain weak for every judgement claim, which is accurate rather than a defect - the product is specified to say 'N sources say this, you do not have it', and a truthfully weak label supports that. Job 1-4 skill builds, coefficients, damage lines and rotations were not examined and carry no claim from this pass.
